EndText: Commandant, I've been staying at Dreamglow Gardens, the place we talked about before, where my flower field can be projected, and you can experience becoming a seed... which reminds me, have you been using the meals I prepared for you before? —Liv

Commandant, where are you now? I'm already in the safe zone at the Logistics Center. I still need to retrieve experimental samples from the Science Council, and finish calibrating the equipment within the time limit. Also, the mechanical arms here are still undergoing maintenance, so avoid wandering and stay clear of construction areas. Reply when you can so I can adjust the route ahead of time and keep things efficient. —Lee

Heard you were looking for me? Babylonia is full of wandering Constructs, and dealing with them is a hassle, so I've been spending time at the Skyring Image Gallery instead. I don't stay there all the time though, so if you really want to find me, try checking a few places. I also ran into Asimov at the Logistics Center. Judging from the way he looked, he's probably working on another experiment. —Teddy

Commandant, I filmed some footage near the Knowledge Promenade just now. After finishing my mission, I heard people talking about new activities being held around Babylonia to liven up the mood, so I went to take a look. The cinema is screening new films, the Olympia Art Gallery opened an exhibition featuring Golden Age and Reconquista Age works, and the Logistics Center is gathering new ingredients that might lead to dishes no one has tried before... I might be rambling. Anyway, there is a lot to see here. When you have a free moment, let's explore it together. —Lucia

Can anyone in Babylonia hear this? This is the Arctic Route Union. The glaciers suddenly split open and a massive number of Corrupted flooded out. Everything is in chaos, and New Sophiasburgh is under attack. Rosetta fell into a coma while trying to protect us... I heard she has already been sent to Babylonia. Please, you have to help her! —Anonymous
